# SafeNet strongSwan source

This directory contains strongSwan 6.0.7 source under the GNU General Public
License, version 2 or later. The upstream license text is in `COPYING`.

- Core source: official 6.0.7 release archive from https://download.strongswan.org/strongswan-6.0.7.tar.bz2
- Release archive SHA-256: `e518e34e159514f4c6ba80d1f926cb151e0dd4e3a1d94213171234b8b9ae6f55`
- Android frontend: official strongSwan Git tag `6.0.7`, commit `5973ff8e41deef4e015e1138a2de688acedf6f75`

The release archive does not contain the Android frontend, so that directory is
included from the matching official Git tag. Keep both source portions and
their upstream license notices when building or distributing SafeNet.
